plugins.name: sherpa
plugins.description: Develop like a sherpa: composable /frame, /shape, /implement skills — one per layer (macro, shape, build) — with bundled scout/shape-builder/review/build subagents. The user composes the workflow; nothing persists unless you call /persist. Extend via project packs.
